title: Cat Fails to Squeeze Through Balcony Fence After Owner Attaches Spatula to Her Harness
description: This cat was playing on the balcony when she tried to squeeze through the fence. But she couldn’t get out because her owner had attached a spatula to her harness as a safety measure to keep her from escaping and to avoid constant supervision. When the cat attempted to slip through the bars, the spatula on her back blocked her, preventing her from getting out.
